name: Liga Stavok
note: Russian bookmaker; premium partner and exclusive bookmaker of HC Shanghai Dragons for the 2026-27 KHL season (Stavki.ru, 2026-09-02; Vedomosti, 2026-09-02), with its logo reported on the team's kit. Club president Ilya Kovalchuk and bookmaker president Yuri Krasovsky signed the agreement. Ownership of the betting company not traced from a primary document.
